name: cnpj-sanction-check
title: Brazil CNPJ Sanction Check: CEIS, CNEP, CEPIM and Leniency
description: Screens Brazilian suppliers by CNPJ against four CGU federal sanction registries on the Portal da Transparencia: CEIS, CNEP, CEPIM and Acordos de Leniencia. One clear or flagged row per company, with source links. Needs your own free Portal token. Not a certidao or legal advice; federal lists only.

company-checked.eventDescription: One CNPJ screened against four CGU federal registries, CEIS, CNEP, CEPIM and Acordos de Leniencia, with verdict, records and source links.

batch-report.eventDescription: The run summary: how many companies were checked, how many were flagged, which of the four registries were read and when. Charged once per run, only when at least one company was checked.
